title: Rundeck: Go JOSE provides an implementation of the Javascript Object Signing and Encryption set of… (CVE-2026-116587)
description: A high-severity security vulnerability exists in the Rundeck package affecting versions prior to 6.0.1-r11. The issue involves the Go JOSE library, which implements Javascript Object Signing and Encryption standards including JWE, JWS, and JWT. The vulnerability does not impact confidentiality or integrity but results in a high impact on availability. A fix is available in Rundeck version 6.0.1-r11.
